name: openmetadata
description: OpenMetadata (1.13.x) as the governance catalog of an on-prem data platform, built from a code-level capability study of 1.13.3 (commit 255f6694): architecture, entity model (JSON Schema), extension points and deployment footprint; connector and lineage coverage for Kafka, Flink, Iceberg, MinIO, ClickHouse, Trino, dbt, Spark, Airflow, NiFi, Great Expectations, Ranger and Vault; a prioritised gap catalog with implementation routes on OpenMetadata's real structures; KVKK (Turkish data protection law 6698) compliance mapping and gaps; a 14-domain / 90-capability governance assessment rubric with evidence discipline and DataHub/Atlas comparison; and new LLM, agentic and ontology capability candidates with novelty checks and a design template
